now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#10
now.text: After Coulson has Andrew Garner assess Joey for Daisy's Secret Warriors, Joey joins the mission that rescues Coulson and Fitz from Hydra's castle.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The director who has Joey rescued and brought into the Secret Warriors.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman Coulson has rescued, who later helps save him from Hydra.

proposed.text: Joey joins the Secret Warriors' raid on Hydra's castle and helps barricade the portal room so Coulson and Fitz can make it back from Maveth.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The director who has Joey rescued, and whom Joey helps bring back from Maveth.

changes.evidence: In 'Maveth' (S3#10) Mack leads the raid on the castle; Joey saves Daisy from Giyera, volunteers to reinforce the portal-room barricade with his powers, then returns to Zephyr One while Mack and Daisy wait at the portal for Coulson and Fitz. The text's opening clause (Garner assessing Joey) is from 'Purpose in the Machine' (S3#2) and 'Chaos Theory' (S3#7), not this episode. Card line also wrong on who brings Joey in: in 'Closure' (S3#9) acting director Mack green-lights the Caterpillars/Secret Warriors and makes Joey and Lincoln official agents, not Coulson.
